+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import datetime
+import re
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MONTH_NUMBERS = {
+    "january": 1,
+    "february": 2,
+    "march": 3,
+    "april": 4,
+    "may": 5,
+    "june": 6,
+    "july": 7,
+    "august": 8,
+    "september": 9,
+    "october": 10,
+    "november": 11,
+    "december": 12,
+}
+_MONTH_ABBREVIATIONS = {name[:3]: number for name, number in _MONTH_NUMBERS.items()}
+
+_ISO_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})")
+_DAY_MONTH_YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]{3}) ([0-9]{4})")
+_MONTH_DAY_YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z]+) ([0-9]{1,2}), ([0-9]{4})")
+_DAY_SLASH_MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{4})")
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _parse_iso(text: str) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+    match = _ISO_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    return int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(3))
+
+
+def _parse_day_month_year(text: str) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+    match = _DAY_MONTH_YEAR_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    month = _MONTH_ABBREVIATIONS.get(match.group(2).lower())
+    if month is None:
+        return None
+    return int(match.group(3)), month, int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def _parse_month_day_year(text: str) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+    match = _MONTH_DAY_YEAR_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    month = _MONTH_NUMBERS.get(match.group(1).lower())
+    if month is None:
+        return None
+    return int(match.group(3)), month, int(match.group(2))
+
+
+def _parse_day_slash_month(text: str) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+    match = _DAY_SLASH_MONTH_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    return int(match.group(3)), int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(1))
+
+
+def handle_normalize_date(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("date")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+    text = raw.strip()
+    parsed = (
+        _parse_iso(text)
+        or _parse_day_month_year(text)
+        or _parse_month_day_year(text)
+        or _parse_day_slash_month(text)
+    )
+    if parsed is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+    year, month, day = parsed
+    try:
+        iso = datetime.date(year, month, day).isoformat()
+    except ValueError:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+    return 200, {"date": iso}
